text: For the director of music. Of David. A petition. Hasten, O God, to save me; O Lord, come quickly to help me.
be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
turn back because of their shame.
rejoice and be glad in you; may those who love your salvation always say, “Let God be exalted!”
come quickly to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O Lord, do not delay.
